newsitem.title: USA: Universal Forest to buy Hi-Tek Forest.
newsitem.headline: Universal Forest to buy Hi-Tek Forest.

text.p: Universal Forest Products Inc, which makes wood products for the do-it-yourself retail and manufactured housing markets, said Wednesday it signed a purchase agreement to buy Hi-Tek Forest Products Inc.
Hi-Tek, which makes roof and floor trusses for factory manufactured homes, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Alpine Engineered Products Inc of Pompano Beach, Fla.
Universal Forest said the agreement is structured as an asset purchase with closing scheduled following a reasonable due diligence period.

"This acquisition should be accretive to future earnings per share, while meeting one of our stated objectives of increasing market share in existing businesses, namely (do-it-yourself) and manufactured housing," William Currie, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "The addition of Hi-Tek's market presence will significantly compliment our position in the manufactured housing industry."
